"I-it's me."
"So it's you."
Everyone looked at Endo, relieved.
"All right, I'm starting."
Sawada began to chant the incantation.
And when she finished...
With a crash of thunder, Endo's body rose into the air and moved toward the demon.
"If I remember right, you grant wishes, don't you?"
"............yes............"
The demon said it in a voice that made the ground shake.
"Then give those girls ugly faces and miserable lives."
Endo flung the words out.
"............yes............"
"What are you saying? You're the one who drew the short straw!"
Sawada said, her voice shaking.
"That's right. You all get to keep your lives, so what's the problem?"
Endo said it in a bright, and eerie, voice.
The girls fainted.{p}
